newsitem.title: USA: Tenneco files for $275 mln in preferred.
newsitem.headline: Tenneco files for $275 mln in preferred.

text.p: Tenneco Inc said on Friday that it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $275 million in its Junior Preferred Stock.
The offering will be made through Morgan Stanley & Co, the Greenwich, Conn-based company said.
The net proceeds will be used to repay a portion of the Tenneco Energy Consolidated Debt in accordance to the Debt Realignment, the company said.
Tenneco is a diversified industrial company conducting all of its operations through its subsidiaries.
